retour.es: ida y vuelta; billete de vuelta

texto: When purchasing a train ticket, it is distinguished between «een enkele reis» (one-way trip only) and «een retour» (one round-trip). In the windows and machines of the Netherlands and Flanders are usually paid by bank card using the «Kan ik pinnen?» formula (can I pay by card?).

frases.nl: Een enkele reis naar Breda, alstublieft.
frases.es: Un billete de ida a Breda, por favor.
frases.en: A one-way ticket to Breda, please.

frases.nl: Nee, alleen de heenreis. Kan ik pinnen?
frases.es: No, solo la ida. ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta?
frases.en: No, just the one-way. Can I pay by card?

frases.nl: Ja. De trein vertrekt van spoor drie.
frases.es: Sí. El tren sale de la vía tres.
frases.en: Yeah. The train leaves track three.

frases.nl: Dank u. Hoe laat vertrekt hij?
frases.en: Thank you. What time does it leave?

bloques.pregunta: What kind of ticket does the ticket traveller request in the box office?

opciones.explicacion: «Een enkele reis» is a simple one-way ticket.

opciones.texto: An unlimited monthly payment of transport
opciones.explicacion: It does not ask for long-term fertilizers.

opciones.texto: A combined round-trip ticket on the same day

opciones.texto: If the passenger plans to return today to offer you a return ticket.
opciones.explicacion: «Vandaag terug» asks if he comes back in the day.

opciones.texto: If the traveller has an international credit card
opciones.explicacion: The consultation on payment then arises at the initiative of the traveller.
